use_cases.title: Outside-study import
use_cases.text: At the film library or medical-records desk: read the outside CD, organize its studies and hand standard DICOM to your existing import step.

use_cases.title: Patient discharge media
use_cases.text: Consolidate a patient's discs onto one USB drive with a standard DICOMDIR for discharge or transfer, instead of burning another CD.

use_cases.title: Second-opinion intake
use_cases.text: Programs that receive discs by mail can process them in one place and get an inventory of what each disc contained.

compliance.text: Not a medical device: software solely to transfer, store, convert or display images (FDA MDDS guidance, Sept 2022; FD&C §520(o)(1)(D)); never interprets.
No BAA needed: we never receive or access PHI (HHS HIPAA FAQ 256). Support works only with de-identified screenshots or logs — please never send us PHI.
